plan.title: Award L1 vendor and approve proposal

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ with two bids directly on Master QCS.
Enable the required eRFX project setting before accessing the prepared awarding case.
Confirm both bidding vendor columns are present with real names.
Verify the second vendor's bid rate is 90, identifying the stated L1 vendor B.
Verify the L1 vendor bid covers the prepared quantity.
Confirm the lower bid ranks first.
Open the awarding screen for the closed event.
Allocate all 10 units to the L1 vendor.
Confirm one of two vendors is awarded and the proposal total is 10 × 90 = 900.
Create the award proposal from the completed allocation.
Complete mandatory proposal fields before submission.
Confirm the proposal is awaiting approval before the approver acts.

args.need: sign in as the approver, open this submitted proposal from Approvals, enter the remark "OK — QA", and approve it

steps.note: A separate approver session is required to complete the requested approval.
After approval, complete purchase-order creation for the awarded bid.
Verify the resulting purchase order contains the awarded line with quantity 10.
